description: Phased redevelopment of an existing residential estate to provide new homes (Use Class C3), including associated cycle and vehicle parking, landscaping and amenity spaceFor the Purposes of Public Consultation but does not form part of the Description of Development: The phased redevelopment of the existing residential estate comprises 138 new homes, refurbishment of 29 homes, and redevelopment of 11 homes (Use Class C3), with buildings ranging from 4 to 6 storeys.
